SILENT STRIKE - where to put your stuff
=======================================

1) YOUR CHARACTER PICTURES
   Put PNG files here:

   public/sprites/chars/char1.png
   public/sprites/chars/char2.png
   public/sprites/chars/char3.png
   public/sprites/chars/char4.png
   public/sprites/chars/char5.png

   Use a MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). The game cuts that color out.

2) YOUR SWORD PICTURES
   public/sprites/weapons/weapon1.png
   public/sprites/weapons/weapon2.png
   public/sprites/weapons/weapon3.png
   public/sprites/weapons/weapon4.png
   public/sprites/weapons/weapon5.png

3) YOUR ITEM PICTURES
   public/sprites/items/bomb.png
   public/sprites/items/reveal.png
   public/sprites/items/heal.png
   public/sprites/items/speed.png
   public/sprites/items/shield.png

4) CHANGE UNLOCKS (how many kills / wins)
   File:  src/game/loadout.ts
   Look for  CHARACTERS  and  WEAPONS
   Change  need: { kills: 10, wins: 0 }
   Example: weapon 2 unlocks at 10 kills.

5) CHANGE ITEM DAMAGE / TIMES
   File:  src/game/items.ts
   BOMB_DMG = 1.5
   BOMB_RANGE = 52
   REVEAL_TIME = 10
   SPEED_TIME = 8
   HEAL_AMT = 2
   DROP_CHANCE = 0.7     (0.7 = 70% drop when someone dies)

6) 360 SWING / HIT RANGE
   File:  src/game/engine.ts  (top of file)
   HIT_RANGE = 42
   SWING_TIME = 0.5

7) MENU MUSIC
   public/audio/menu.mp3
